nodes.label: Release Tag as Single Source of Truth
nodes.description: A vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH tag is the release authority; the release script synchronizes three user-visible version fields and the tag-triggered workflow validates their agreement.

nodes.label: Two-Level Release Dry Run
nodes.description: Local dry-run verifies version diffs without writes, while manually dispatched CI builds an artifact without publishing a release; tag pushes alone authorize publication.

nodes.label: Linux-Only Release Scope
nodes.description: The current pipeline publishes only a Linux x86_64 binary tarball and explicitly excludes desktop bundles, crates.io/npm publishing, and changelog generation.

edges.description: Both dry-run modes verify parts of the tag-authorized release workflow without publishing.
The release contract states the artifacts currently produced by tag publication.
